title: Carabineros PPD Artnel 2 — FINAL v2
subtitle: Systemic Pattern Confirmed — Carabinero Officer: 'casi todos los días se ve en alguien detenido por agresión'
location: Carabineros Dartnell sub‑station, Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport, Santiago, Chile
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

participants.role: Carabinero Officer — primary institutional speaker, makes pattern admissions

violations_cited: LPDC Art. 23 bis — failure to provide lawful written reasons
CPCL Art. 197 — falsification of private document (unsigned carta)
Systemic institutional practice of false detentions — 'casi todos los días'
Abuso de autoridad — forcible removal without valid cause
Concealment of official document by LATAM, PDI, DGAC
Violation of passenger rights under CACH Art. 131, 133
Pattern evidence for class‑wide liability and consumer fraud

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: A different Carabinero previously told passenger that this pattern 'pasa con mucha frecuencia' — distributed institutional knowledge.
Female Carabinero #2 begins with alcohol/alteration assumption; passenger corrects and officer backpedals — documenting institutional presumption of passenger guilt.
Passenger quantifies damages: 48+ hours stranded, no food, no support — all caused by false accusation.
Officer acknowledges LATAM gives nothing to accused passengers: 'Cuando al frente no dan de nada.'
Joaquín Barraza identified as LATAM security chief; PDI chief also named Barraza — investigative lead regarding possible relationship.
Carabineros computer system runs Internet Explorer and crashes; passenger provides tech support — reveals institutional infrastructure failures.
★ CRITICAL ★ Female Carabinero #2 states: 'Es de siempre, casi todos los días, que se ve en alguien detenido por agresión' — systemic daily pattern confirmed.
Officer recommends: 'hágale una denuncia a ellos porque ya es' — direct instruction from law enforcement to file complaint against LATAM.
Passenger's account of shifting narratives (aggression → boarding pass) is perfectly consistent with all prior recordings.
Officer confirms: 'Es que ellos siempre hacen eso' — LATAM's conduct is characteristic, not incidental.
Officer previously told another detained passenger to file complaint — multiple victims, consistent advice.
Third-party passengers independently contacted Leandro with video evidence of forcible removal.
